reviews.title: Poor map zoom control on iPhone
reviews.text:
As a truck driver, I rely on Trucker Path every day, but the map zoom on my iPhone is very frustrating. The map shows too large an area, sometimes including nearby towns several miles away, making it difficult to clearly see upcoming turns and road details on the small phone screen.

I would like to be able to zoom in and keep the map at my preferred zoom level, showing approximately 2–3 miles of the road ahead instead of 5–6 miles. Unfortunately, there is currently no option to disable automatic zoom adjustments or save a preferred zoom level.

Interestingly, the map zoom works well for me on my tablet, but the view on my iPhone is too far out. I contacted support, but they confirmed that these customization options are not currently available.

Please add an option to control and lock the map zoom level, especially for phone users. This would make navigation much more practical and safer for truck drivers.

reviews.title: Money-hungry app developers
reviews.text:
This is supposed to be a professional truck navigation app, but it fails at basic navigation. It doesn’t provide all the information advertised, takes way too long to recalculate when you miss a turn, and sometimes tells you to make U-turns on narrow roads where turning around a truck is extremely difficult or even unsafe.

Instead of fixing these basic issues, the company seems more interested in pushing users to upgrade to Diamond membership, claiming it will provide the cheapest and fastest routes. Seriously? I’m already paying $20 a month, and the app still struggles with basic navigation.

Charging extra for features like CarPlay navigation is ridiculous, especially when the core navigation experience isn’t even reliable. Truck drivers need accurate routing, quick recalculations, and safe directions — not constant upselling and overpriced memberships.

Fix the actual problems before asking your paying customers for even more money. A truck navigation app should prioritize safety and reliability, not squeezing every last dollar out of its users. Absolutely frustrating experience.

reviews.title: I’ve been using this app for 4 years
reviews.text: In the beginning I loved this app it helped me avoid low bridges and roads that are not semi friendly and it never steered me wrong. I’ve been doing the updates, I’ve reset my phone, I’ve turned my internet on and off but I’m still running into the same issue. Every time I try to look up an address on the main screen it will pull up the address and when I select directions, I get a pop up that says “something went wrong.” Then I select the trips option and the app will work long enough for me to get 3 or 4 addresses in. I’m having to type them really fast cause suddenly the app will stop working and I can’t type any more addresses. I use to be able to put 9 addresses and now I’m rushing for some reason to get 3 or 4. Then it just stops. I think it’s the app cause I will shut off my phone, reset my phone, check for app updates, turn my data or WiFi on and off and this issue won’t stop happening. I hope someone reads this and takes the feedback serious after all I’ve been paying for this app for 4 years going on 5 now. This use to never be a problem and I’ve had the same phone iPhone 13 Pro. It shouldn’t be the phone.

reviews.title: Waste of $
reviews.text:
I paid for the Trucker Path subscription expecting it to help plan safe and legal routes for a semi truck, but it completely failed when it mattered most. The whole reason I paid for the premium version was to avoid situations like this, yet this morning the route it suggested still led to my driver getting a ticket.

If drivers are paying for a navigation service specifically designed for truckers, it should reliably account for truck routes, restrictions, and anything that could cause a violation. Instead, we ended up with a costly ticket, which defeats the entire purpose of paying for the app in the first place.

For the price of the subscription, I expected much better accuracy and reliability. Right now it just feels like a waste of money.
